dr-d-bekker-kenridge.description:
This general dental practice in the Kenridge Centre on Mildred Street, Durbanville, looks after the oral health of patients of all ages, from young children to older adults. Its focus is on prevention, helping patients keep their teeth and gums healthy so that bigger problems are avoided later on.

Patients can book routine check-ups and professional cleans, and the practice also carries out restorative work to repair teeth that have been damaged or affected by decay. The team combines modern dental techniques with a gentle, unhurried manner, creating a comfortable setting that helps patients relax. Advice on brushing, flossing and daily habits is part of each visit, supporting long-term oral health for the whole family. The practice is at 1 Mildred Street in the Kenridge Centre, Durbanville.

dis-chem-ottery.description:
Dis-Chem Ottery is a large-format branch of the national pharmacy chain, trading from Shops 27 to 31 in Ottery Hyper on New Ottery Road. Its dispensary fills prescriptions and its pharmacists give professional advice, while an in-store clinic offers health services for families who prefer not to wait for a doctor's appointment for everyday concerns.

The front shop carries a wide range of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and supplements, along with beauty and skincare, baby essentials and health foods. Having medicine, toiletries and baby supplies under one roof makes it easy for parents to tick off several items on a single trip. Good value and knowledgeable staff make it a practical everyday pharmacy for households across Ottery and the surrounding suburbs. Dis-Chem is at Shops 27–31, Ottery Hyper, New Ottery Road, Ottery.

kfc-plattekloof-village-shopping-centre-.description:
KFC Plattekloof Village is a branch of the international fried-chicken chain inside Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre on Plattekloof Road. It serves KFC's Original Recipe fried chicken alongside crispy chicken burgers, wraps and golden chips.

The restaurant suits busy shoppers grabbing a bite during errands, families looking for an easy meal out and commuters picking up dinner on the way home. Customers can sit down and eat in the restaurant or order a takeaway to enjoy at home, and service is quick and friendly either way. The kitchen is kept to high standards, so diners get the same familiar, consistent taste on every visit. For Plattekloof residents and people working nearby, it is a convenient local spot for a fast meal. KFC is at Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre, Plattekloof Road.

shoprite-bothasig-bothasig.description:
Shoprite Bothasig is the Shoprite supermarket in Bothasig Square, at the corner of Vryburger Avenue and Tafelberg Street. True to the national chain's focus, it is all about helping households stretch their budget with low prices on everyday essentials.

The store carries fresh seasonal fruit and vegetables, meat, freshly baked bread and treats, pantry staples and household goods, so families can buy everything for the week in one place. Regular promotions add extra savings, and efficient service at the tills keeps queues moving. Whether it is a quick stop for milk and bread or a full monthly shop, it is a dependable option for Bothasig residents and nearby suburbs, located right in the neighbourhood's main shopping centre. Shoprite is at Bothasig Square, corner Vryburger Avenue and Tafelberg Street, Bothasig.

shoprite-middestad-bellville.description:
Shoprite Middestad is a busy Shoprite supermarket inside Middestad Mall on Charl Malan Road in central Bellville. Close to public transport, it is an easy stop for commuters, workers in the CBD and families who rely on taxis, buses and trains to get around.

In line with the chain's low-price approach, the store offers an extensive range of affordable groceries, including fresh fruit and vegetables, meat, baked goods, pantry staples and household items. Weekly promotions help customers save even more, and the tills are run efficiently to cope with the steady flow of shoppers. From a quick lunchtime top-up to a full month-end shop, it gives Bellville residents and people passing through town good value in a central location. Shoprite is inside Middestad Mall, 30 Charl Malan Road, Bellville.

spar-cedar-bothasig.description:
SPAR Cedar is a neighbourhood SPAR supermarket at the corner of Vryburger Avenue and Botma Street in Bothasig, set up for the everyday shopping needs of the local community. It is close enough to home for a quick stop after work, yet stocked well enough for a full weekly shop.

The store carries a good variety of fresh seasonal fruit and vegetables, quality meat, pantry staples and household essentials, so families can pick up dinner ingredients midweek or fill a trolley for the month ahead. Shoppers often mention the clean, tidy store and the warm, family-friendly service at the tills. Competitive prices round out the appeal, making it a dependable local supermarket for Bothasig households. SPAR Cedar is on the corner of Vryburger Avenue and Botma Street, Bothasig, Cape Town.

spar-pinelands.description:
SPAR Pinelands is the SPAR supermarket in Central Square, at the heart of Pinelands, looking after the day-to-day grocery needs of the suburb's residents. Its central spot makes it easy for locals to pop in on foot or by car, whether for a few items or a bigger shop.

Inside, shoppers will find seasonal fruit and vegetables, a butchery with quality meat, freshly baked bread and treats, and all the household basics a family goes through in a week. Staff are friendly and welcoming, the store is kept clean and tidy, and prices are competitive, which together keep regulars coming back. It works just as well for grabbing ingredients for tonight's supper as for a full monthly stock-up. SPAR Pinelands is at Shop 1, Central Square, Pinelands.

woolworths-food-richmond-corner-richwood.description:
Woolworths Food at Richmond Corner is a neighbourhood Woolworths food store in the shopping centre at the corner of Plattekloof and Tygerberg Valley roads, Richwood. It gives Milnerton and Richwood families easy access to Woolworths groceries without a trip to one of the larger malls.

The shelves are stocked with seasonal fruit and vegetables, including organic lines, sustainably sourced meat, freshly baked bread and pastries, and ready-made meals that make a quick, quality dinner on busy evenings. The store's clean, orderly layout keeps a quick shop quick, and the staff are on hand to help when needed. For households that want fresh, carefully sourced food for the week close to home, it is a convenient stop on the way back from work or school. Woolworths Food is at Shop 05, Richmond Corner, Richwood, Milnerton.

woolworths-muizenberg.description:
The Woolworths food market in Capricorn Square, at the corner of Prince George Drive and Dury Road, serves shoppers in Muizenberg and the nearby False Bay suburbs. It brings the retailer's focus on freshness, quality and sustainability to a convenient neighbourhood centre.

On the shelves are organic and seasonal fruit and vegetables, ethically sourced meat, bakery breads and pastries, and a selection of ready-made meals for easy lunches and dinners. Staff are helpful and the store is well organised and spotless, making it simple to get in and out on a weekday evening or take time over a bigger weekend shop. For local families who want fresh, responsibly sourced groceries without a drive to a large mall, it is a practical choice close to home. Woolworths is at Shop 26, Capricorn Square, Muizenberg.

woolworths-noordhoek.description:
Woolworths at Longbeach Mall on Buller Louw Boulevard is one of the centre's main anchor stores, serving shoppers in Noordhoek and the surrounding valley. The store reflects the retailer's commitment to fresh food, consistent quality and sustainable sourcing.

Its aisles offer seasonal and organic produce, ethically sourced meat and poultry, bakery items and a broad choice of prepared meals for quick, wholesome dinners. Day-to-day household groceries are stocked as well, making it a practical place for the main weekly shop. Customers find the store easy to navigate thanks to its tidy layout, and the staff are helpful when something can't be found. For families in the valley, it means quality groceries close to home without a trip across the mountain. Woolworths is at Shop G25, Longbeach Mall, Noordhoek.

woolworths-plumstead.description:
Woolworths Plumstead is a Woolworths food market in the 3Arts Village shopping centre on Main Road, Plumstead. It focuses on fresh, quality groceries, reflecting the national retailer's emphasis on freshness and responsible sourcing.

Shoppers will find fresh produce, including organic fruit and vegetables, quality cuts of meat and baked goods from the in-store bakery section, alongside ready-made meals for nights when there is no time to cook. Household essentials are on the shelves too, so a weekly shop can be done in one stop. The store is clean and neatly laid out, which makes it quick to find what's needed, and staff are helpful when customers have questions. For Plumstead residents who value fresh, quality food close to home, it is a convenient local choice. Woolworths is at 3Arts Village, 260 Main Road, Plumstead.

woolworths-vangate-mall-athlone.description:
Woolworths at Vangate Mall on Vanguard Drive is the Athlone branch of the well-known South African retailer, combining fashion and a food market in one store. Shoppers can browse contemporary clothing for men, women and children, along with footwear, all with the quality and durability Woolworths is known for.

The food market section stocks fresh produce, including organic options, as well as ready-made meals that make weeknight dinners easy, plus everyday household essentials. Being able to pick up clothes for the family and groceries for the week in one visit makes it a convenient stop for busy households. For families in Athlone and the surrounding suburbs, it brings Woolworths quality to a local mall without the need to travel further afield. Woolworths is at Shop 92, Vangate Mall, Vanguard Drive, Athlone.

francor-bakery-parow.description:
Francor Bakery is an independent neighbourhood bakery on West Street in Parow, baking fresh goods every day for the local community. Its shelves are filled each morning with traditional breads, crusty rolls, sweet pastries and savoury pies, ready for breakfast, lunch boxes or an afternoon treat.

The bakers use tried-and-tested recipes and quality ingredients to get the taste and texture right batch after batch. As well as everyday baking, the bakery makes custom cakes for birthdays and other special occasions, so customers can order something made to suit their celebration. Friendly service and affordable prices make it a popular corner stop for Parow residents, and the smell of fresh baking greets customers as they walk in. Francor Bakery is at 46 West Street, Parow.

global-components-epping.description:
Global Components is a motor spares supplier at the corner of Tripper Avenue and Bofors Circle in Epping Industria, one of Cape Town's main industrial areas. It stocks a wide range of parts for many vehicle makes and models, supplying passenger cars as well as commercial fleets.

Customers include workshops, fleet operators and individual motorists, who can source engine parts, braking components, electrical parts and service essentials from one supplier. The team sources its stock carefully and offers knowledgeable advice to help customers get the right part for the job, which saves time and avoids return trips. Efficient service and durable parts help keep vehicles running safely and keep repair costs under control. Global Components is on the corner of Tripper Avenue and Bofors Circle, Epping Industria.

lakeside-pharmacy-lakeside.description:
Lakeside Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy on Main Road in Lakeside, serving residents of Lakeside, Muizenberg and the surrounding area. Its pharmacists dispense prescriptions and help customers choose from a carefully selected range of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and supplements.

As an independent pharmacy, it puts personal service first, with staff who take time to offer friendly advice, health consultations and help with keeping track of ongoing health needs. The shelves also hold everyday personal care products, toiletries and first-aid supplies, so customers can pick up household essentials while collecting their medication. Being right on Main Road makes it easy to pop in during the day. For locals who prefer a personal neighbourhood pharmacy, it is a welcoming choice. Lakeside Pharmacy is at 62 Main Road, Lakeside.

miladys-noordhoek.description:
Miladys at Longbeach Mall is the Noordhoek branch of the women's fashion brand known for dressing real women of all shapes and sizes. The store offers comfortable, stylish clothing, footwear and accessories designed to flatter a range of body types, so customers can find pieces that fit well and feel good to wear.

Collections cover relaxed casual wear for weekends and smart-casual outfits suitable for work and outings, with an emphasis on good-quality fabrics that hold up to everyday wear. Shoes and accessories make it easy to complete a look in one visit. Staff offer warm, personal service, helping customers find the right size and style without any pressure. For women in Noordhoek and the surrounding valley, it is an inviting place to refresh a wardrobe. Miladys is at Longbeach Mall, Buller Louw Boulevard, Noordhoek.

pinelands-hardware-central-square-pinela.description:
Pinelands Hardware is an independent hardware store in Central Square, Pinelands, that has served the suburb's residents for decades. It stocks a broad range of tools, building materials, plumbing fittings and electrical components, covering most of what is needed for repairs and improvements around the home.

The store mixes paint to order and cuts keys while customers wait, and its garden section carries equipment and supplies for keeping local gardens in shape. What regulars value most is the old-fashioned service: friendly staff who know their products and take time to give practical advice, whether a customer is fixing a dripping tap or planning a bigger renovation. For Pinelands homeowners, it is a convenient neighbourhood store for quality hardware and sound advice. Pinelands Hardware is at 12 Central Square, Pinelands.

spar-bellville-mall-bellville.description:
SPAR Bellville Mall is the SPAR supermarket inside Bellville Mall, at the corner of Voortrekker Road and Bill Bezuidenhout Avenue. Its central position on one of Bellville's main roads makes it a handy grocery stop for local residents as well as people working or passing through the area.

The store stocks fresh seasonal produce, quality meat from its butchery counter, bread and baked goods made fresh, and the everyday household items families need. Shoppers mention the clean, well-kept store and the warm service from staff, and prices are competitive with other supermarkets nearby. Whether customers are after a couple of ingredients for supper or doing their full weekly shop, the store covers both needs in one convenient place. SPAR is inside Bellville Mall, on the corner of Voortrekker Road and Bill Bezuidenhout Avenue, Bellville.

tafelsig-moslem-butchery-tafelsig.description:
Tafelsig Moslem Butchery is a neighbourhood butchery on Huguenot Street in Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain, supplying halaal meat prepared in line with Islamic dietary requirements. It is a well-used local shop for families who want fresh, halaal meat close to home.

The counter carries fresh beef cuts, lamb chops, chicken, mince and traditional sausages, covering everything from a pot of curry or a family stew to a weekend braai. Prices are kept affordable, which matters for households buying meat every week, and the staff are friendly and give personal service to regulars and newcomers alike. The welcoming atmosphere and dependable quality have made it a fixture in the community. Tafelsig Moslem Butchery is at 3 Huguenot Street, Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain.

thornton-service-station-thornton.description:
Thornton Service Station is a BP fuel station on Sipres Avenue in Thornton, serving local residents, daily commuters and drivers passing through the area. Friendly attendants fill up vehicles with petrol or diesel, giving motorists a quick, full-service stop on their way to work or home.

The forecourt has air points for checking and inflating tyres, helping drivers keep their vehicles safe on the road, and the station keeps its facilities clean for customers. Inside, the convenience store sells snacks, cold drinks and everyday essentials, so drivers can grab something to eat or drink while they refuel. For Thornton residents, it is a handy neighbourhood garage that combines fuel, basic vehicle care and a quick snack in one stop. Thornton Service Station is at 58 Sipres Avenue, Thornton, Cape Town.

woolworths-liberty-promenade-beacon-vall.description:
Woolworths Liberty Promenade is the Woolworths in Mitchells Plain's busy regional mall at the corner of AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road, Beacon Valley. As one of the mall's anchor stores, it brings Woolworths' fresh food and quality standards within easy reach of families across Mitchells Plain.

The food hall offers organic and seasonal produce, ethically sourced meat, baked goods and a range of ready-made meals for nights off from cooking, supported by the retailer's commitment to sustainable sourcing. Household groceries make it possible to complete the weekly shop here too. The clean, orderly layout makes shopping straightforward, and staff are helpful if customers need assistance. Rather than travelling into the southern suburbs, local shoppers can find Woolworths quality right in their own community. Woolworths is at Liberty Promenade, Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain.

brackenfell-dental-brackenfell.description:
Brackenfell Dental is a dental practice in the Brackenfell Medical Centre, at the corner of Brackenfell Boulevard and Old Paarl Road. It offers general and preventive dentistry for the whole family, from children's first check-ups to ongoing care for adults and older patients.

The practice's services include routine examinations, deep cleans, fillings and root canal treatment to save teeth that might otherwise be lost, as well as cosmetic treatments for patients who want to improve the appearance of their smile. An experienced team uses modern dental technology and takes a gentle, patient-centred approach to keep visits as comfortable as possible, which is reassuring for anyone nervous about the dentist. Being part of a medical centre makes it easy to find and convenient to visit. Brackenfell Dental is at Suite 3, Brackenfell Medical Centre, Brackenfell.

dr-i-bux-southfield.description:
This general practice in the Glaymont Centre on Victoria Road, Southfield, provides primary healthcare for individuals and families in the surrounding suburbs. Patients are seen for acute illnesses that need prompt attention as well as long-term chronic conditions that need regular follow-up, so the same doctor can manage their care over time.

Routine health checks help pick up problems early, and preventative advice is part of each consultation, giving patients practical steps to stay well. The practice takes a compassionate, patient-centred approach, making time to listen and explain treatment clearly. For Southfield residents looking for a regular family doctor close to home, it offers accessible, dependable care from an established local GP. The practice is at Unit 3, Glaymont Centre, 161 Victoria Road, Southfield.

inn-hair-milnerton.description:
Inn-Hair is a unisex hair salon on Loxton Road in Milnerton, cutting and styling hair for men, women and children. Its stylists work with a wide range of hair types, so the whole family can be looked after at the same salon.

Services run from precision cuts and quick trims to blow-dries, colour, highlights, conditioning treatments and creative styling for special occasions. The team uses quality professional products to keep hair healthy and colour looking vibrant, and takes care to make each client comfortable in the chair. Whether someone needs a regular tidy-up or a complete change of look, they can expect personal attention and a polished result. For Milnerton residents, it is a convenient neighbourhood salon close to home. Inn-Hair is at Shop 4, Loxton Road, Milnerton.

marhaba-khans-take-aways-delft-mall-delf.description:
Marhaba Khan's Take Aways is a takeaway counter in Delft Mall, at the corner of Hindle Road and Delft Main Road, serving quick, filling meals at prices that suit everyday budgets. It is popular with shoppers in the mall as well as local families looking for an easy meal.

The menu sticks to favourite Cape comfort food, including grilled burgers, golden chips and the classic gatsby, a long roll packed with fillings that is ideal for sharing at a party or with the family. Everything is made hot and fresh to order, and portions are generous. Service is quick, so customers can collect their food without a long wait and carry on with their day. For a satisfying meal in Delft, it is a convenient stop inside the mall. Marhaba Khan's Take Aways is at Shop 42A, Delft Mall.

medi-kem-pharmacy-athlone.description:
Medi-Kem Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on Belgravia Road in Athlone with deep roots in the local community. Its pharmacists dispense prescriptions and help customers choose from a wide selection of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and health supplements.

The team offers health screenings and practical, personal advice, taking time to explain medication and answer questions in a warm and caring way. Alongside medicines, the pharmacy keeps everyday personal care items, toiletries and first-aid supplies, so customers can collect a prescription and pick up household essentials in the same visit. Its easy-to-reach spot on Belgravia Road makes it a convenient stop for Athlone families looking for a dependable neighbourhood pharmacy. Medi-Kem Pharmacy is at 77 Belgravia Road, Athlone, Cape Town.

taaz-tours-kenwyn.description:
Taaz Tours is a travel agency based at Rockford Place on Rockford Road in Kenwyn, planning trips for clients travelling within South Africa and overseas. The agency puts together personalised itineraries, taking care of the arrangements so travellers can look forward to the trip rather than worry about the details.

Its services include booking flights and hotels, organising family holidays and arranging business travel for companies, as well as building custom tour packages to suit different budgets. The team pays careful attention to each booking and is known for reliable customer care. Whether someone is planning a weekend away, a family holiday or a work trip, the agency offers a local, personal alternative to booking everything online. Taaz Tours serves Kenwyn and the Southern Suburbs from 2 Rockford Place, Rockford Road, Kenwyn.

kalk-bay-gallery-kalk-bay.description:
Kalk Bay Gallery is an art gallery on Main Road in Kalk Bay, set in the heart of the historic fishing village on the False Bay coast. It shows and sells contemporary South African art, including paintings, sculpture and handmade ceramics, giving visitors the chance to take home an original piece.

The gallery features work by established South African artists alongside up-and-coming talent from the region, so its collection offers something for seasoned collectors as well as people buying their first artwork. Carefully arranged displays make it easy to browse at a relaxed pace, and the welcoming atmosphere suits both serious art lovers and curious passers-by. For tourists exploring Kalk Bay's shops and harbour, and for locals looking for a meaningful gift, it is a worthwhile stop. Kalk Bay Gallery is at 62 Main Road, Kalk Bay.

woolworths-hout-bay.description:
Woolworths Hout Bay is one of the anchor stores in Mainstream Mall on Mainstream Avenue, giving residents of the Hout Bay valley a Woolworths food market on their doorstep. As with the national chain, the emphasis is on fresh, good-quality food sourced with care for the environment.

Customers can stock up on organic and fresh produce, good cuts of meat and baked goods, along with prepared meals that save time on busy days. Household essentials are available as well, so the weekly shop can be wrapped up in one trip. Shelves are well arranged and the store is kept clean, and staff are helpful on the floor. Because Hout Bay sits a fair drive from the bigger city malls, having a full Woolworths food store in the village is especially convenient for locals. Woolworths is at Shop B8, Mainstream Mall, Hout Bay.

busy-corner-butchery-grassy-park.description:
Busy Corner Butchery is a long-standing neighbourhood butchery on Victoria Road in Grassy Park, and true to its name, it is a busy spot for local families stocking up on fresh meat. The counter offers a wide range of cuts prepared with care, from beef steaks and lamb chops to traditional boerewors, chicken and soup meat.

Customers come here for good-quality meat at affordable prices, whether they are buying for everyday family meals or planning a weekend braai. The shop keeps high standards of hygiene, and the staff behind the counter are friendly and know their meat, happy to advise on the right cut or cut to order. For Grassy Park households, it is a dependable local butcher that has served the community for many years. Busy Corner Butchery is at 1 Victoria Road, Grassy Park, Cape Town.

woolworths-meadowridge.description:
This Woolworths food store in the Park 'n Shop Shopping Centre on Firgrove Road is the local Woolworths for Meadowridge and the neighbouring Constantia Valley suburbs. Set in a smaller neighbourhood centre, it makes for an easier, quicker shop than the big regional malls.

Shoppers can choose from organic and seasonal fruit and vegetables, responsibly sourced meat, breads and pastries from the bakery section, and ready meals for evenings when time is short, all backed by the retailer's commitment to freshness and sustainability. Everyday household groceries complete the range. The store is neat and clearly laid out, and staff are always willing to help find a product. For families in Meadowridge and surrounding areas, it is a convenient spot for quality groceries close to home. Woolworths is at Park 'n Shop Shopping Centre, Firgrove Road, Meadowridge.

cash-converters-ottery.description:
Cash Converters in Ottery Hyper on New Ottery Road is a branch of the national franchise that buys and sells quality second-hand goods. Shoppers can find pre-owned electronics, household appliances, musical instruments and tools at prices well below new, while people looking to declutter can sell items they no longer need for cash.

Every item is tested before it goes on sale, giving buyers confidence in what they take home. Beyond retail, the store offers short-term cash loans and pawn options, allowing customers to borrow against valuable goods and collect them once the loan is repaid. Staff explain the terms clearly and deal with customers openly and honestly. For Ottery residents wanting to save money on household goods or raise cash quickly, it is a convenient local option. Cash Converters is at Shop L53, Ottery Hyper, Ottery.

medirite-pharmacy-fairbridge-mall-bracke.description:
Medirite Pharmacy in Fairbridge Mall on Old Paarl Road is a retail pharmacy serving Brackenfell families, part of the Shoprite group's Medirite chain. Its pharmacists dispense prescriptions, including ongoing chronic medication, and help customers choose from a wide range of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and supplements.

The team gives personal health advice and offers routine wellness screenings, helping customers keep an eye on their health between doctor's visits. Prices are kept affordable, which makes a real difference for households collecting medication every month. Because the pharmacy is inside the mall, customers can drop off a script, finish their grocery shopping and collect their medicine on the way out. Everyday personal care items are also on the shelves, so a single stop covers several needs. Medirite is at Shop 82, Fairbridge Mall, Brackenfell.

saverite-ruyterwacht.description:
Saverite Ruyterwacht is a neighbourhood supermarket on Paul Kruger Avenue, at the Vereeniging circle in Ruyterwacht, serving the daily grocery needs of local families. It offers a friendly, convenient alternative to travelling to a large mall for the weekly shop.

The store stocks fresh seasonal fruit and vegetables, dairy, baked goods, pantry staples and household cleaning products, covering both a quick midweek top-up and a full family shop. Saverite keeps its prices competitive and runs regular promotions, helping households make their money go further. Being right in the neighbourhood means many customers can walk to the store, and its central spot makes it an easy stop on the way home. For Ruyterwacht residents, it is a practical, affordable local supermarket. Saverite is at 2 Paul Kruger Avenue, Ruyterwacht, Cape Town.

steers-bothasig-bothasig.description:
Steers Bothasig is a branch of the South African flame-grilled burger chain in Bothasig Square on Vryburger Avenue. The menu is built around flame-grilled food, from the Original King Steer burger, cheese burgers and chicken burgers to flame-grilled chicken and loin pork ribs, served with Steers' hand-cut chips.

For something sweet, the branch serves thick milkshakes, soft-serve swirls and ice-cream cones. Customers can eat in at the counter-service restaurant or take their meal away, and orders can also be placed for delivery through the Steers app. The branch is listed as family friendly, with a kids' menu, and card payments are accepted. It is open daily, from 11am on Mondays and Tuesdays and from 10am for the rest of the week, until 10pm. Steers is at Shop 54, Bothasig Square, Bothasig.

steers-welgemoed.description:
Steers Welgemoed is a branch of the South African flame-grilled burger chain inside Welgemoed Forum, at the corner of Kommissaris Street and Jip de Jager Avenue. It serves the chain's signature flame-grilled beef burgers alongside ribs, crispy chicken and Steers' well-known hand-cut chips, made fresh in store.

The restaurant is a popular stop for local families, residents and commuters wanting a quick, satisfying meal that tastes the same every time. Diners can sit down and eat in the restaurant or order takeaway to enjoy at home or on the go. Service is friendly and fast, and the kitchen is kept to high standards of cleanliness. For anyone in Welgemoed and the surrounding northern suburbs craving a flame-grilled burger, it is a convenient local option. Steers is inside Welgemoed Forum, Welgemoed, Cape Town.

sunningdale-pharmacy-parklands.description:
Sunningdale Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy in Parklands Shopping Centre on Link Road, looking after the everyday health needs of families in Parklands and Sunningdale. Its pharmacists dispense prescriptions and help customers choose from a wide range of over-the-counter medicines, vitamins and health supplements.

Being independent, the pharmacy puts personal care first, with a knowledgeable team that takes time to give advice and offers health consultations for common concerns. The shelves also carry everyday personal care items, toiletries and first-aid supplies, so customers can pick up household basics while collecting their medication. Its spot in the local shopping centre makes it easy to combine a pharmacy visit with other errands. For Parklands residents, it is a dependable neighbourhood pharmacy close to home. Sunningdale Pharmacy is at Shop 14, Parklands Shopping Centre, Link Road, Parklands.

belkem-pharmacy-macassar.description:
Belkem Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy in the Macassar Shopping Centre, at the corner of Hospital and Burg streets, serving residents of Macassar and the surrounding area. It dispenses prescription medication and is listed on the pharmacy networks of several medical schemes, including the Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), the Wooltru Healthcare Fund and Bankmed, which means members of those schemes can have their scripts filled here.

As a neighbourhood pharmacy inside the local shopping centre, it gives Macassar families a place to collect chronic and acute medication without travelling further afield. It is listed as open seven days a week, including evenings on weekdays and shorter hours on Saturdays and Sundays. Belkem Pharmacy is at Shop 19, Macassar Shopping Centre, Macassar.

bierman-knoetze-inc-kraaifontein.description:
Bierman Knoetze Inc is an optometry practice in Blochs Centre on Van Riebeeck Road, Kraaifontein, providing eye care for patients of all ages. Its optometrists carry out comprehensive eye examinations and diagnostic tests to check both how well patients see and the overall health of their eyes.

Using modern optical equipment, the practice helps manage common eye conditions such as glaucoma, dry eye and refractive errors like short- and long-sightedness. Once a prescription is confirmed, patients can choose from a selection of spectacle frames, including designer styles, or be fitted with contact lenses. The team combines clinical skill with personal service, taking time to explain results and recommend the best option for each patient's eyes and lifestyle. Bierman Knoetze Inc is at Blochs Centre, Van Riebeeck Road, Kraaifontein.

checkers-liquorshop-sun-valley-sunnydale.description:
Checkers LiquorShop Sun Valley is the Checkers group's bottle store in Sun Valley Mall, at the corner of Noordhoek Main Road and Buller Louw Boulevard in Sunnydale. It sells a wide selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks for shoppers in Sun Valley, Noordhoek and the surrounding area.

The shelves hold local wines, craft beers, imported spirits and ciders, along with mixers and soft drinks, so customers can put together everything for a braai, a dinner party or a quiet evening at home. Competitive prices and regular promotions help shoppers get good value, and the store is neatly laid out, making it easy to find what's needed. Staff are friendly and know their range, offering suggestions when customers want something new to try. Checkers LiquorShop is at Shop 10, Sun Valley Mall, Sunnydale.

about-cats-and-dogs-sun-valley-sunnydale.description:
About Cats & Dogs Sun Valley is a pet supply store in Sun Valley Mall, Sunnydale, part of a Western Cape-founded chain of pet shops. It is dedicated to keeping companion animals healthy and happy, with a wide selection of quality pet foods, nutritional supplements and specialised diets for dogs, cats and small pets.

Beyond food, the shelves hold durable toys, comfortable beds, grooming accessories and collars, so pet owners can find everything their animals need in one visit. m-van-der-scholtz-attorneys-goodwood.description:

woolworths-howard-centre-pinelands.description:

colcacchio-meadowridge.description:

nedbank-the-junxion-mall-philippi.description:

hometown-cafe-rosebank.description:

shoprite-maynard-mall-wynberg.description:

Auto World Midas Bothasig is a motor spares and car accessories store in Bothasig Mall on Vryburger Avenue, part of the national Midas network. It stocks a broad range of parts, tools and accessories for everyday motorists, home mechanics and local workshops.

Shoppers can find engine components and brake parts, along with oils, lubricants and car-care products for keeping vehicles clean and running smoothly. A selection of tools and accessories means DIY enthusiasts can pick up what they need for a weekend service or small repair. Staff behind the counter know their products and help customers find the correct part for their make and model, saving time and wasted trips. For Bothasig drivers who want to look after their vehicles safely and affordably, it is a convenient local stop. Auto World Midas is at Shop 41, Bothasig Mall, 41 Vryburger Avenue, Bothasig.

mr-price-strand.description:
Mr Price in Strand Square on Fagan Street is the Strand branch of the popular South African value-fashion retailer, selling affordable clothing, shoes and accessories for the whole family. The store caters for babies and young children through to teens and adults, so a family can be dressed for the season in one visit.

Everyday basics sit alongside on-trend streetwear and seasonal collections, all priced to help households make their money go further. Shoes and accessories make it easy to complete a look without overspending, and new stock arrives regularly so there is usually something fresh to find. For families in Strand and the surrounding Helderberg area, it is a convenient local store for keeping up with fashion on a budget. Mr Price is in Strand Square, Fagan Street, Strand.

romans-pizza-liberty-promenade-mitchells.description:
Roman's Pizza at Liberty Promenade, on the corner of AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road, is a branch of the South African pizza chain known for its two-pizzas-for-one-price value deals. It serves Mitchells Plain families, mall shoppers and anyone in the area wanting a filling meal that doesn't stretch the budget.

Pizzas come with either a thicker pan base or a traditional thin crust, topped generously with favourites such as pepperoni, creamy chicken and mushroom, and a choice of vegetarian combinations. Cheesy garlic bread and fresh salads are also on the menu, and family deals make it easy to feed a group. Orders are prepared quickly in a well-run kitchen, which suits busy shoppers grabbing supper on the way home. Roman's Pizza is at Shop 190, Liberty Promenade, Mitchells Plain, Cape Town.

absolute-pets-richmond-corner-richwood.description:
Absolute Pets Richmond Corner is a pet store in the Richmond Corner shopping centre, at the corner of Tygerberg Valley and Plattekloof roads in Richwood. It is set up to keep dogs, cats and small pets healthy and happy, with a broad range of quality pet foods, vet-recommended diets and nutritional supplements.

Alongside food, the store carries durable toys, comfortable beds, tick and flea treatments, grooming accessories and pet clothing, so owners can stock up on all their pet's needs in one place. The staff are passionate about animals and well trained, and they take time to help owners choose the right food or product for a pet's breed, age or health needs. For pet owners in Richwood, Milnerton and the surrounding northern suburbs, it is a convenient neighbourhood pet shop. Absolute Pets is at Shop 13, Richmond Corner, Richwood, Milnerton.

clicks-plattekloof-shopping-centre-platt.description:
Clicks Plattekloof is the Clicks health and beauty store in Plattekloof Shopping Centre on Olienhout Avenue, part of the well-known national chain. Its pharmacy dispenses prescriptions, and pharmacists are on hand to give advice on over-the-counter medicines and everyday health concerns.

Beyond the dispensary, shoppers can browse a wide range of beauty brands and skincare products, baby care essentials and practical household items, making it easy to pick up toiletries, a gift or nappies in the same visit as collecting medication. The store is known for good value, with regular specials helping customers save on everyday buys, and friendly, efficient staff keep the shopping experience quick and pleasant. For Plattekloof residents and people working nearby, it is a convenient place for health, beauty and household needs close to home. Clicks is at Plattekloof Shopping Centre, Olienhout Avenue, Plattekloof.

specsavers-howard-centre-pinelands.description:
Spec-Savers Pinelands is the Howard Centre branch of the national optometry group, providing eye tests and eyewear for families in Pinelands and nearby suburbs. Its optometrists carry out comprehensive eye examinations and vision screenings, giving each patient clear advice on their eyesight and the best way to correct it.

Once a prescription is confirmed, patients can choose from a wide range of affordable spectacle frames, including designer styles, along with prescription sunglasses and contact lenses. The store focuses on giving good value without compromising on quality, so customers can find glasses that suit both their eyes and their budget. A friendly, experienced team helps with fitting and frame selection, making the whole process straightforward. For Pinelands residents, it is a convenient place to look after their eyes while shopping at the centre. Spec-Savers is at Shop G06, Howard Centre, Pinelands.

vida-e-caffe-de-waterkant.description:
Vida e Caffè Cape Quarter is a branch of the South African coffee chain in Cape Quarter Square on Somerset Road, De Waterkant. The café blends the feel of a European street-side coffee bar with lively, friendly local hospitality, and is a regular stop for people living and working in the area.

Espresso-based coffees made from Vida's own blends are the main draw, along with iced coffees for warmer days. To eat, there are fresh sandwiches, wraps and light lunch options, as well as sweet baked treats to go with a cup of coffee. The trendy, casual setting works well for a quick meeting with a colleague, an hour of work on a laptop or a fast takeaway coffee on the way into the city in the morning. Vida e Caffè is at Unit D05, Cape Quarter Square, 27 Somerset Road, De Waterkant.

wavecrest-pharmacy-strandfontein.description:
Wavecrest Pharmacy is a community pharmacy in Wavecrest Plaza, at the corner of Benguela and Wavecrest avenues in Strandfontein, and part of the Alpha Pharm group of independently owned pharmacies. It provides residents with prescription dispensing and professional pharmaceutical advice close to home.

As well as prescription and over-the-counter medicines, the pharmacy stocks everyday health products, baby essentials and basic wellness items, so families can take care of several needs in one stop. Being an independently owned pharmacy within the Alpha Pharm network, it combines the backing of a national group with the personal, friendly service of a neighbourhood business. Customers can count on reliable guidance on their medication and practical advice on minor ailments. For Strandfontein households, it is a convenient local pharmacy for everyday health needs. Wavecrest Pharmacy is at Shop 4, Wavecrest Plaza, Strandfontein.

woolworths-food-steenberg-village-tokai.description:
Woolworths Food in Steenberg Village on Reddam Avenue is the neighbourhood Woolworths for Tokai, Steenberg and the surrounding southern suburbs. It focuses on fresh, carefully sourced food and a convenient, easy shop close to home.

The aisles are stocked with organic produce, sustainably sourced meat, freshly baked bread and pastries from the bakery section, and ready-to-eat meals for evenings when there is little time to cook. Customers can also pick up everyday household staples, speciality ingredients for entertaining and a selection of wines. The store reflects Woolworths' emphasis on taste, ethical sourcing and new product ranges, and staff provide friendly, efficient service at the tills and on the floor. For local families, it is a practical choice for both the weekly shop and last-minute dinner ingredients. Woolworths Food is in Steenberg Village, Reddam Avenue, Tokai.

cashbuild-gugulethu-square-gugulethu.description:
Cashbuild Gugulethu is the local branch of the national building materials retailer, trading from Shop 81 in Gugulethu Square on NY3. It supplies people building or extending their homes, local contractors and DIY enthusiasts with the materials and tools they need.

The store stocks building essentials such as cement, bricks and timber, along with roofing materials, plumbing supplies, electrical components and hand tools, covering everything from a small repair to a full building project. Cashbuild's focus is on keeping prices affordable and stock reliably available, so builders can buy what they need without delays. Knowledgeable staff in store help customers work out quantities and choose the right materials for the job. villa-massage-spa-bantry-bay.description:
Villa Massage Spa is a boutique massage and wellness spa on Ave Marina in the coastal suburb of Bantry Bay, on Cape Town's Atlantic Seaboard. Treatments are offered strictly by appointment, which keeps the spa calm and quiet and allows each guest an unhurried, personal experience.

The treatment menu includes deep tissue massage to ease tight muscles, aromatherapy massage for relaxation, and hot stone therapy that uses warmed stones to release tension. Guests can also book wellness packages that combine treatments for a longer session of pampering. Experienced therapists work in a peaceful, comfortable setting close to the sea, making the spa a welcome escape from busy routines. It suits both local residents looking for regular bodywork and visitors staying in the area who want to relax after a day of exploring. Villa Massage Spa is at 20 Ave Marina, Bantry Bay.

afya-pharmacy-bellville.description:
Afya Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy in the Tygerberg Centre on busy Voortrekker Road, Bellville, offering accessible, affordable healthcare to people living, working and commuting through the area. Its pharmacists fill prescriptions efficiently and give personal advice on medicines and common health complaints.

The shelves carry over-the-counter remedies, health supplements and daily vitamins, alongside personal care products and first-aid supplies for the home or workplace. An experienced, friendly team takes time with each customer, whether they are collecting regular medication, looking for something to ease a cold or asking how to take a new prescription. Its central location on one of Bellville's main roads makes it easy to reach on foot or by public transport. For locals who value individual attention from their pharmacist, it is a dependable choice. Afya Pharmacy is at 3 Tygerberg Centre, 16 Voortrekker Road, Bellville.

central-pharmacy-mitchells-plain.description:
Central Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy on Minuet Lane in the Mitchells Plain Town Centre, one of the busiest shopping areas in the southern Cape Flats. It serves local families with prescription dispensing, over-the-counter medicines and professional health advice.

On the shelves, customers will find daily vitamins and supplements, personal care products, baby essentials such as nappies and baby care items, and basic first-aid supplies. The experienced team is friendly and approachable, taking time to explain how medicines work and offering practical guidance for minor ailments. Being right in the town centre, it is easy to visit while doing other shopping or after getting off a bus or taxi. Central Pharmacy is at 5 Minuet Lane, Mitchells Plain Town Centre.

dunns-philippi-shopping-centre-philippi.description:
Dunns Philippi is a branch of the South African fashion and footwear chain in Philippi Shopping Centre, at the corner of Eisleben and Lansdowne roads. It caters for families on a budget, offering stylish, affordable clothing and shoes for men, women and children.

The range covers casual everyday wear, smarter outfits for each season and essential basics, all following current fashion trends while staying within reach of most budgets. A good selection of footwear, from everyday shoes to trendier styles, makes it easy to complete a look. Staff are friendly and helpful, and the store's spot inside the shopping centre means it fits easily into a regular shopping trip. For Philippi residents wanting to refresh the family's wardrobe without overspending, it offers good value close to home. Dunns is at Shop 14, Philippi Shopping Centre, Philippi, Cape Town.

kfc-welgemoed.description:
KFC Welgemoed is the KFC restaurant in Welgemoed Forum, at the corner of Jip de Jager Road and Kommissaris Street, serving the chain's well-known fried chicken to families and shoppers in the northern suburbs. For Welgemoed residents and people visiting the Forum, it is a convenient spot for a familiar, filling meal. KFC is inside Welgemoed Forum, Welgemoed, Cape Town.

anchor-pharmacy-athlone.description:
Anchor Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy on Lawrence Road in Athlone, with strong ties to the neighbourhood it serves. The shop stocks vitamins and immune-support supplements, baby care products, personal toiletries and first-aid essentials, so families can pick up what they need for the household while collecting medication. beta-kem-pharmacy-mitchells-plain.description:

edgemead-optical-centre-edgemead.description:

oxford-stationers-gardens-shopping-centr.description:
Oxford Stationers is a stationery, book and picture-framing shop in Gardens Shopping Centre, at the corner of Mill and Buitenkant streets. It serves students, people working from home or nearby offices, artists and families in Gardens and the surrounding city bowl.

Its central spot in the local shopping centre makes it a handy neighbourhood stop. Oxford Stationers is at Shop 16, Gardens Shopping Centre, Gardens.

bargain-books-howard-centre-pinelands.description:
Bargain Books Pinelands is a branch of the South African bookshop chain in Howard Centre, at the corner of Howard and Forest drives. The store is known for offering a wide range of books at good prices, making reading more affordable for families and book lovers.

Shelves are stocked with local bestsellers, international fiction, non-fiction and biographies, while a large children's section helps parents find picture books, early readers and stories for older children. Alongside the books, the store sells educational toys, greeting cards and everyday stationery, so it doubles as a handy gift shop. clicks-westlake.description:

compass-bakery-kommetjie.description:
Compass Bakery is a commercial bakery at Heron Park on Kommetjie Road, Kommetjie, best known locally for the factory shop on site that is open to the public. As well as baking for retail customers, the bakery lets residents and visitors buy its products directly at outlet prices.

convenient-motor-spares-delft.description:

steenberg-pharmacy-steenberg.description:

woolworths-grassy-park-grassy-park.description:

a-h-mckenzie-and-associates-goodwood.description:
A H McKenzie & Associates is a boutique law practice on Voortrekker Road in central Goodwood, giving tailored legal advice and representation to both private individuals and businesses. For businesses, the firm drafts and reviews commercial contracts, and it represents clients in general litigation when a dispute has to be resolved formally. The attorneys are open about costs and process, keep to high ethical standards and aim to make legal advice easy to understand, guiding clients through complicated matters as efficiently as possible. A H McKenzie & Associates is at 94B Voortrekker Road, Goodwood, Cape Town.

shoprite-delft.description:
Shoprite Delft is the anchor supermarket in Delft Mall, at the corner of Hindle Road and Delft Main Road, and a central part of daily life for many families in the area. kfc-the-junction-mall-philippi.description:

pep-cell-delft-mall-delft.description:

ok-furniture-eerste-river.description:
OK Furniture Eerste Rivier is a furniture and appliance store in Eerste Rivier Mall, at the corner of Plein and Van Riebeeck streets. Part of the national OK Furniture chain, it helps families furnish their homes with good-quality pieces at prices that suit a tighter budget.
