The school is closely involved with the surrounding community and aims to give every learner a well-rounded education that builds both academic ability and character. For Portland and neighbouring Mitchells Plain families, it is a local option for secondary schooling close to home. Portland Secondary School is on the corner of Merrydale and Morgenster roads, Mitchells Plain.

settlers-gas-and-hardware-bonteheuwel.description:
Settlers Gas & Hardware is a neighbourhood hardware store and household gas supplier on Bonteheuwel Avenue, serving Bonteheuwel residents and local contractors. LP gas refills are a mainstay of the business, alongside heaters and heating essentials for the colder months, so households can keep cooking and warm without travelling far.

The hardware side of the store covers hand tools, plumbing materials, electrical fittings and basic building supplies, as well as everyday DIY equipment for repairs and small projects around the home. Prices are kept affordable, and the staff are welcoming and practical, offering sensible advice on what to buy and how to tackle a job. For contractors, having building and plumbing basics close to the site saves time on busy days. Settlers Gas & Hardware gives the neighbourhood quick, convenient access to gas and hardware essentials. It is at 468 Bonteheuwel Avenue, Bonteheuwel, Cape Town.

tops-at-spar-heathfield-heathfield.description:
Tops at Spar Heathfield is the bottle store attached to the Spar supermarket on Main Road, Heathfield, giving local residents and passing commuters an easy place to buy drinks alongside their groceries. The store is clean and neatly laid out, making it quick to find a favourite or browse for something new.

Its shelves cover local and imported beers, South African wines, spirits, ciders and sparkling wines and champagnes for celebrations. Prices are competitive and promotions run regularly, helping customers get good value whether they are buying for a quiet dinner, a weekend braai or a festive gathering. Friendly staff are happy to recommend a wine to go with a meal or suggest drinks for a party. For Heathfield and the surrounding southern suburbs, it is a convenient neighbourhood bottle store. Tops at Spar is at 35 Main Road, Heathfield, Cape Town.

ackermans-bothasig-bothasig.description:
Ackermans Bothasig is the local branch of the national value-fashion chain, trading from Shop 4 in Bothasig Square on Vryburger Avenue. It helps families dress well on a budget, with affordable, good-quality clothing for everyone at home.

The store is especially strong on babywear and children's clothing, and it stocks hard-wearing school uniforms that are in demand at the start of every term. Adults can choose from contemporary everyday fashion, while a cellular section offers phones and airtime and a small home range covers practical household items. The bright, well-organised store makes it easy to find sizes and styles quickly, and helpful staff are on hand when shoppers need assistance. For Bothasig families, it is a convenient place to keep growing children in clothes without overspending. Ackermans is at Shop 4, Bothasig Square, Vryburger Avenue, Bothasig.

standard-bank-noordhoek.description:
Standard Bank's Longbeach Mall branch on Buller Louw Drive serves individuals and businesses in Noordhoek and across the South Peninsula. It offers everyday transactional banking alongside personal and business loans, foreign exchange and investment products, so most banking needs can be handled in one place.

Self-service terminals and ATMs make routine deposits, withdrawals and account queries quick, while consultants are available for more involved conversations about borrowing, saving or growing wealth. Business owners can get support with their company banking and finance, and travellers can arrange foreign currency before a trip. Being inside the mall means a visit to the bank fits easily into a regular shopping run, which is convenient for residents who would otherwise travel further for a full-service branch. Standard Bank is inside Longbeach Mall, Buller Louw Drive, Noordhoek, Cape Town.

broadway-confectionery-bakery-maitland.description:
Broadway Confectionery & Bakery is a Portuguese-style bakery and café on Voortrekker Road in Maitland, a long-standing local favourite for fresh bread and treats. Its counters are filled with traditional European-style breads, freshly baked pastries and cakes, including the classic Portuguese custard tarts known as pastéis de nata.

Customers can buy over the counter to take home or sit down in the cosy café with an espresso and something sweet. Celebration cakes can be ordered and decorated for birthdays, weddings and other special occasions. The bakery is popular for an early breakfast on the way to work, a quick lunch and an afternoon coffee break, and its welcoming atmosphere keeps locals coming back. For anyone in Maitland and nearby suburbs who enjoys freshly baked goods made from scratch, it is well worth a visit. Broadway Confectionery & Bakery is at 109 Voortrekker Road, Maitland.

coniston-motors-steenberg.description:
Coniston Motors is a busy fuel station and convenience garage on the corner of Military Road and Prince George Drive in Steenberg, one of the main crossroads for traffic heading through the southern suburbs. It is a regular stop for daily commuters as well as residents of Steenberg and the surrounding neighbourhoods.

Forecourt attendants fill up vehicles quickly and efficiently, and drivers can check their tyre pressure before getting back on the road. The convenience shop on site stocks snacks and cold drinks for the journey, along with a selection of everyday groceries for anyone who needs to pick up bread or milk on the way home. Safety and convenience are priorities, making it easy to refuel and restock in a single stop. Coniston Motors is on the corner of Military Road and Prince George Drive, Steenberg, Cape Town.

dr-m-s-jassiem-steenberg.description:
This general practice on Military Road in Steenberg provides primary healthcare for patients of all ages, from babies and children to adults and older patients. It is an important point of care for families in Steenberg and the surrounding neighbourhoods, offering everyday medical attention close to home.

Patients can be seen for acute illnesses that need prompt treatment, get ongoing help in managing chronic conditions, and book routine health screenings to catch problems early. Preventative wellness consultations give practical advice on staying healthy and reducing future health risks. The practice is known for professional, compassionate care in a welcoming and supportive setting, with time taken to listen to each patient and explain their treatment. For local families who want a regular doctor they can rely on, it offers dependable care in the community. The practice is at 541 Military Road, Steenberg, Cape Town.

jmr-body-works-epping.description:
JMR Body Works is a panelbeating and spray-painting workshop in Barkley Park on Bofors Circle, Epping Industria. Established in 1995, it has been repairing vehicles for more than 30 years, building up long experience in accident and body repair.

The workshop handles full accident repairs, chassis straightening to bring a damaged frame back into line, dent removal and spray-painting finished to factory standard so repaired panels match the rest of the car. It works for private vehicle owners, companies with fleets and insurance clients, handling everything from a minor scrape to major collision damage. Modern equipment and quality materials help restore each vehicle to its original specifications, so it looks right and is safe to drive. For motorists across the northern suburbs who need dependable body repair, it is an experienced local option. JMR Body Works is at Unit C, Barkley Park, 82 Bofors Circle, Epping Industria.

caltex-cobble-walk-durbanville.description:
Caltex Cobble Walk is a 24-hour service station at the corner of Legato Drive and Verdi Boulevard in Sonstraal Heights, Durbanville, right beside Cobble Walk Shopping Centre. It is a busy stop for local residents and commuters travelling through the northern suburbs.

The forecourt offers Caltex fuels with engine-cleaning additives, along with an air pump for checking tyre pressure. There are ATMs on site for drawing cash, and a car wash for drivers who want their vehicle cleaned while they are there. Customers can also pick up drinks, snacks and other travel essentials before heading off. With fuel, a car wash and cash all in one place next to the mall, it makes a practical stop on the school run, the commute or a weekend outing. Caltex Cobble Walk is at 66 Legato Drive, Sonstraal Heights, Durbanville.

fourie-basson-and-veldtman-parow.description:
Fourie Basson & Veldtman is an established firm of attorneys with offices in Toplinhuis on Voortrekker Road, Parow. The practice advises and represents companies, small businesses and private individuals across the northern suburbs and greater Cape Town.

Its work covers civil litigation, family law, property law and the administration of deceased estates, and the team includes conveyancers who handle the registration of property transfers. That breadth means a client can turn to the same firm when buying a home, going through a divorce, settling a business dispute or winding up a family member's estate. Experienced attorneys focus on practical, sensible solutions that protect each client's interests over the long term, and they work to high ethical standards throughout. For clients who want a dependable local law firm, it offers a wide range of legal services under one roof. Fourie Basson & Veldtman is at Toplinhuis, 219 Voortrekker Road, Parow.

heroes-cape-town-cbd.description:
Heroes is a fashion and clothing store in the Golden Acre Shopping Centre on Adderley Street, right in the centre of Cape Town's CBD. It caters for style-conscious city shoppers with a range of current clothing, shoes and accessories.

The focus is on modern streetwear and smart-casual outfits that look good, last well and stay affordable, so customers can refresh their wardrobe for work or weekends without overspending. Footwear and accessories sit alongside the clothing, making it easy to put together a complete look in one visit. Because Golden Acre sits next to the city's main bus, taxi and train connections, the store is a convenient stop for commuters on their way to or from work, as well as office workers on a lunch break and visitors exploring the city. Heroes is in Golden Acre Shopping Centre, 9 Adderley Street, Cape Town.

nedbank-gardens-shopping-centre-gardens.description:
Nedbank's Gardens branch is in Gardens Shopping Centre on Mill Street, serving individuals and businesses across the City Bowl. It provides everyday transactional banking alongside personal and business loans, foreign exchange and wealth management, covering most banking needs in one convenient location.

Self-service terminals and ATMs at the branch let customers deposit and withdraw cash and handle routine account tasks quickly. For bigger decisions, such as taking out a loan, planning investments or setting up business banking, professional consultants are available to talk clients through the options. Residents preparing for travel can also arrange foreign currency here. Its central spot in a busy neighbourhood shopping centre means a bank visit can easily be combined with groceries or other errands, which suits the many people who live and work in and around Gardens. Nedbank is at Shop 64, Gardens Shopping Centre, 38 Mill Street, Gardens.

pick-n-pay-clothing-howard-centre-pinela.description:
Pick n Pay Clothing at Howard Centre, on the corner of Forest and Howard drives, is Pick n Pay's family fashion store for Pinelands and the surrounding suburbs. It sells good-quality, affordable clothing, shoes and accessories for every member of the household.

Shoppers can find comfortable everyday wear, seasonal ranges that change through the year and smart-casual outfits for work or going out. The children's and baby clothing is a particular favourite with parents, offering hard-wearing pieces at prices that make sense for fast-growing kids. Footwear and accessories complete the offer. The store is neatly arranged, so it is easy to find sizes and styles, and the staff are supportive and happy to help. For Pinelands families looking for value without sacrificing quality, it is a convenient local clothing store. Pick n Pay Clothing is at Shop G36, Howard Centre, Pinelands.

shoprite-makhaza-khayelitsha.description:
Shoprite Makhaza is the main supermarket in Makhaza Shopping Centre, at the corner of Japhta K Masemola and Cekeca roads in Khayelitsha. It is a busy, well-stocked store that gives local households affordable access to their weekly groceries close to home.

Shoppers can buy fresh fruit and vegetables, meat, freshly baked bread and the pantry staples families rely on, all at Shoprite's low prices. An attached liquor shop sits alongside the supermarket, and the store's service counters let customers pay utility bills, send and receive money and buy tickets during the same visit, saving extra trips into town. Efficient tills help manage the crowds on busy weekends and at month-end. For Makhaza residents, it brings groceries and everyday services together in one convenient place. Shoprite is at Makhaza Shopping Centre, corner Japhta K Masemola and Cekeca roads, Khayelitsha.

steers-kromboom-rd-rondebosch-east.description:
Steers Kromboom Road is a branch of the South African flame-grilled burger chain, on the first floor of 134 Kromboom Road in Rondebosch East. It serves local residents and commuters with Steers' familiar menu of flame-grilled beef burgers and chicken, together with the chain's well-known hand-cut chips.

Value combos make it easy to put together a filling meal at a good price, whether for one person or the whole family. Customers can eat in the clean, welcoming restaurant or collect a takeaway to enjoy at home, and the friendly staff keep service moving quickly at busy times. It suits a quick lunch during the working day, a casual family supper or a bite on the way home. For anyone in Rondebosch East and the surrounding southern suburbs craving a flame-grilled burger, it is a convenient local choice. Steers is at Shop 3, 1st Floor, 134 Kromboom Road, Rondebosch East.

woolworths-plattekloof.description:
Woolworths Plattekloof is the Woolworths store in Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre, at the corner of Plattekloof Road and Baronetcy Boulevard, serving households across Plattekloof and the neighbouring northern suburbs. Its food market is the main draw, with fresh, sustainably sourced produce, organic meat, ready-made meals and freshly baked bread and pastries.

Beyond groceries, the store carries a selection of homeware and clothing for the family, so shoppers can pick up something for the house or a new outfit alongside their weekly food shop. The staff are attentive and helpful, and the store's layout makes it easy to move between the food hall and other departments. For local residents who want Woolworths quality across food, fashion and home in one convenient stop, it is a practical choice close to home. Woolworths is at Plattekloof Village Shopping Centre, corner Plattekloof Road and Baronetcy Boulevard, Plattekloof.

dr-h-goolam-strandfontein.description:
This general practice on Dennegeur Avenue in Strandfontein offers family medical care for patients of every age, from young children to grandparents. It is a familiar point of care for residents of Strandfontein and the surrounding False Bay communities who want a doctor close to home.

Consultations cover the treatment of sudden illnesses and infections, regular check-ups for people living with chronic conditions, and routine health screenings that help spot problems early. The practice also gives preventative advice to help patients protect their long-term health. Care is professional and compassionate, delivered in a welcoming, supportive environment where patients feel comfortable discussing their concerns. For local families looking for a dependable GP they can return to over the years, the practice is a convenient choice. It is at 65B Dennegeur Avenue, Strandfontein, Cape Town.

woolworths-liberty-promenade-mitchells-p.description:
Woolworths Liberty Promenade is the Woolworths fashion store at Shop 23 in Liberty Promenade, on the corner of AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road in Mitchells Plain. It gives shoppers in Mitchells Plain and the surrounding Cape Flats a local place to buy Woolworths clothing without travelling into town.

The store dresses the whole family, with a range that runs from everyday wardrobe staples to smarter, more current pieces for work, weekends and special occasions. Woolworths clothing is known for the quality of its fabrics and for lasting well through regular wear and washing, which is why many local shoppers come back to it when they want style and value in the same purchase. Because it sits inside the mall, a visit is easy to combine with other errands at Liberty Promenade. Woolworths is at Shop 23, Liberty Promenade, corner AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road, Mitchells Plain.

fashion-city-golden-acre-cape-town-cbd.description:
Fashion City is a fashion and clothing store in the Golden Acre Shopping Centre in the heart of the Cape Town CBD. It caters for style-conscious city shoppers, commuters and locals who want to update their wardrobe affordably.

The store stocks a wide mix of contemporary clothing, from eye-catching statement pieces for a night out or special occasion to the everyday basics people wear to work and on weekends. Shoes and accessories are displayed alongside the clothing, so customers can match an outfit and complete their look in a single visit. Its location in Golden Acre, next to the city's main bus, taxi and train connections, makes it easy for commuters to browse on their way to or from work or during a lunch break. Fashion City is in Golden Acre Shopping Centre, 9 Adderley Street, Cape Town.

spar-vangate-mall-athlone.description:
SPAR Vangate Mall is the SPAR supermarket inside Vangate Mall on Jakes Gerwel Drive, Athlone, serving families from Athlone and the surrounding communities. The well-organised store covers the full weekly shop, with fresh produce, pantry staples and household essentials on its shelves.

Fresh food counters add to the appeal: a butchery with quality cuts of meat, a bakery section with freshly baked bread and treats, and a hot-food deli serving ready-made meals that are handy for busy evenings or a quick lunch at the mall. Prices are kept affordable, and the friendly staff help make shopping quick and easy, even when the centre is busy. Its location in one of Athlone's main malls means customers can combine their grocery shopping with banking and other errands. SPAR is at Shop 10, Vangate Mall, Jakes Gerwel Drive, Athlone, Cape Town.

pep-strand.description:
PEP Strand is the PEP store in Strand Square on Fagan Street, giving Strand residents and holidaymakers an affordable place to shop for the whole family. PEP is one of the best-known budget clothing names in South Africa, and this branch focuses on good everyday value close to home.

The store carries a wide selection of reliable clothing for men, women, children and babies, from wardrobe basics to outfits for school, work and weekends. Alongside the clothing, shoppers will find basic homeware, affordable tech items and other everyday necessities. The branch is also a Paxi point, so customers can send and collect parcels at the counter during the same visit. Its central spot in Strand Square makes it easy to pop in while running other errands in town. PEP is at Strand Square, 21 Fagan Street, Strand.

african-bank-eerste-river-eerste-river.description:
African Bank Eerste River is the African Bank branch at 8 Plein Street, inside the Grand Central Shopping Centre in Eerste River. It serves residents of Eerste River and the surrounding eastern suburbs who prefer to handle their banking in person, close to home.

The branch offers African Bank’s range of retail banking products, including day-to-day transactional accounts, savings accounts, personal loans and investment options. Consultants help customers open accounts, apply for credit and choose the products that suit their needs, and service at the branch is quick and efficient. The bank describes itself as a bank “for the people, by the people”, with its focus on everyday South Africans. The branch has wheelchair access, and its spot in the shopping centre makes it easy to combine a bank visit with other errands. African Bank is at Grand Central Shopping Centre, 8 Plein Street, Eerste River.

woolworths-brackenfell-corner-brackenfel.description:
Woolworths Brackenfell Corner is a Woolworths Food store in Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre, on the corner of Frans Conradie Drive and Paradys Street near St Michaels. As one of the main stores in the open-air centre, it serves Brackenfell households who want good-quality groceries without a long trip.

Fresh food is the focus, with organic fruit and vegetables, sustainably sourced meat and other proteins, and a wide choice of ready-made meals for quick weeknight suppers. An in-store bakery offers fresh bread and pastries, and a coffee station lets shoppers pick up a drink on the way in or out. The store is neatly organised, which makes it easy for shoppers to find what they need on a short visit, and it keeps longer trading hours over the weekend. For a quick, well-stocked food shop close to home, it is a convenient local stop. Woolworths is at Shop 1, Brackenfell Corner Shopping Centre, corner Frans Conradie Drive and Paradys Street, Brackenfell.

capitec-bank-nyanga-junction-manenberg.description:
Capitec Bank Nyanga Junction is the Capitec branch at Shop 28 in Nyanga Junction Shopping Centre on Duinefontein Road, where Manenberg borders Gugulethu. It is a busy local branch for residents of Manenberg, Gugulethu, Nyanga and the surrounding Cape Flats communities.

Customers can open a savings account, apply for a personal loan, look at Capitec’s insurance products and take care of everyday transactions with the help of branch consultants. Capitec is known for simple, affordable banking with clear fees, and the branch makes good use of the bank’s app and self-service technology to keep visits short. A 24-hour ATM next to the branch lets customers draw cash safely outside branch hours. Being inside one of the area’s main shopping centres, it is easy to sort out banking during a regular shopping trip. Capitec Bank is at Shop 28, Nyanga Junction Shopping Centre, Duinefontein Road, Manenberg.

game-liberty-promenade-mitchells-plain.description:
Game Mitchells Plain is the Game discount store at Entrance 1 of Liberty Promenade Shopping Centre, on the corner of AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road. It is a large general merchandise store serving households across Mitchells Plain and the neighbouring Cape Flats suburbs.

The store covers a wide spread of departments under one roof. Shoppers can compare TVs and home entertainment systems, smartphones and major household appliances, and browse furniture, fitness equipment and everyday groceries in the same visit. Game is known for keen prices on big-brand electronics and home essentials, which makes this branch a popular place locally for larger purchases as well as the regular shop. It is open seven days a week, with longer trading hours on weekdays, so it is easy to fit a trip in after work. Game is at Entrance 1, Liberty Promenade Shopping Centre, corner AZ Berman Drive and Morgenster Road, Mitchells Plain.

kwik-spar-flamingo-square-table-view.description:
Kwik Spar Flamingo Square is the neighbourhood SPAR in Flamingo Square Centre, on the corner of Blaauwberg Road and Study Street in Table View. It is a handy daily grocery stop for local families and for commuters heading home along Blaauwberg Road.

Fresh food is the store’s strength. An in-store bakery turns out fresh bread and baked treats, the hot deli counter serves ready-made meals for an easy lunch or supper, and the fresh produce section includes a good choice of organic fruit and vegetables. Pantry staples and household essentials fill the rest of the shelves, so a quick top-up shop can easily cover the whole list. Shoppers mention the friendly staff and the neat, well-organised layout, and the centre has secure free parking. The store keeps long trading hours, staying open late into the evening every day. Kwik Spar is at Shop 15, Flamingo Square Centre, corner Study Street and Blaauwberg Road, Table View.

shaheems-barber-southfield.description:
Shaheem’s Barber is a gents’ barber shop at 229 Victoria Road in Southfield, well regarded locally for its friendly service and relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. It serves men and boys from Southfield and the surrounding southern suburbs who want a reliable cut close to home.

The team of SETA-certified barbers and hair stylists covers the full range of gents’ grooming. Clients can come in for a precise haircut or a fresh style, have their beard neatly trimmed and shaped, or settle in for a traditional razor shave. The shop is air-conditioned, which keeps it comfortable in the Cape summer, and it is wheelchair accessible. Many customers are long-standing regulars who have come back to the same chair for years, which says a lot about the quality and consistency of the work. It is open on weekdays and on Saturday mornings. Shaheem’s Barber is at 229 Victoria Road, Southfield, Cape Town.

barksole-sea-point-sea-point.description:
Barksole Sea Point is the Main Road branch of the Barksole shoe repair chain, best known for fixing and restoring footwear so customers can keep wearing the shoes they love. Its craftsmen repair heels, soles and stitching on everything from work shoes and boots to high heels and everyday sneakers, often saving a favourite pair from the bin.

Alongside shoe repairs, the branch offers a range of handy services under one roof, including key cutting, printing, dry cleaning drop-off and custom-made rubber stamps for businesses and personal use. That mix makes it a practical stop for ticking off several errands at once. Being right on busy Main Road, it is easy for Sea Point residents and people working nearby to drop items off and collect them on the way home. Barksole is at 154 Main Road, Sea Point, Cape Town.

capitec-bank-delft-mall-delft.description:
Capitec Bank's Delft Mall branch, at Shop 34 in Delft Mall on Hindle Road, offers simple, affordable everyday banking to residents of Delft and the surrounding areas. Its consultants help clients open accounts, start saving, apply for personal loans and look at insurance options, all explained in plain language so customers know exactly what they are signing up for.

Day-to-day transactions can be handled in the branch with the help of staff, and clients are shown how to manage their money through Capitec's digital banking so they can make payments and check balances from their phones. ATMs nearby make it easy to draw cash while shopping in the mall. With its focus on low fees and straightforward products, the branch is a practical choice for households that want banking to be easy and transparent. Capitec is at Shop 34, Delft Mall, Hindle Road, Delft.

esacks-pharmacy-hanover-park.description:
Esack's Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy in the Town Centre on Surran Road, at the commercial heart of Hanover Park. It is an important local healthcare resource, giving residents easy access to prescriptions, everyday medicines and health advice without travelling out of the area.

Patients can have their doctor's prescriptions filled, buy over-the-counter remedies and choose from a range of affordable wellness products. The pharmacy team is knowledgeable and approachable, offering personal health advice, routine blood pressure checks and basic clinic services for common health concerns. Being in the busy town centre means families can look after their health needs while doing their regular shopping, whether that is collecting monthly medication or picking up something for a child's cough. For Hanover Park households, it is a dependable neighbourhood pharmacy close to home. Esack's Pharmacy is at Shop 6b, Town Centre, Surran Road, Hanover Park.

xolile-guestrooms-langa.description:
Xolile Guestrooms is a self-catering guest house on Washington Street in Langa, offering visitors a warm, authentic place to stay in one of Cape Town's oldest townships. It is a popular choice for travellers interested in cultural tourism who want to experience township life first-hand rather than from a city hotel.

The guest house has neat, comfortable ensuite rooms with the essentials needed for a restful stay, and guests share a communal kitchen where they can prepare their own meals. The premises are secure, and the hosts create a friendly, welcoming atmosphere that makes independent travellers and groups feel at home. Its location on one of Langa's main historical streets puts heritage sites, community art centres and public transport within easy reach, making it a practical base for exploring both Langa and the wider city. Xolile Guestrooms is at 1 Xolile House, Washington Street, Langa.

absa-bank-gardens-shopping-centre-garden.description:
ABSA's Gardens branch is in Gardens Shopping Centre, at the corner of Mill and Upper Buitenkant streets, and serves residents, shoppers and business owners in Gardens and across the City Bowl. It provides a full range of day-to-day retail banking for both personal and business customers.

Customers can open new accounts, apply for personal or business loans and get expert advice on investments and longer-term financial planning from the branch's consultants. ATMs at the branch accept cash deposits and handle withdrawals, making quick transactions easy while shopping at the centre. Small business owners in the area can use the branch for their business banking needs as well as their personal accounts. Its location in a busy neighbourhood centre means a bank visit fits neatly into other errands, without a trip into the city centre. ABSA is at Shop 55, Gardens Shopping Centre, Gardens.

ackermans-maynard-mall-wynberg.description:
Ackermans Maynard Mall is the Wynberg branch of the national family value retailer, trading from Shop 46 in Maynard Mall on Main Road. It sells affordable, good-quality clothing, shoes and everyday essentials for every member of the family.

Parents know the store best for its large baby clothing range and its trendy, hard-wearing kidswear, which keeps up with fast-growing children without stretching the budget. Adults can find everyday fashion at competitive prices, and a cellular section offers budget phones and related products. Lay-by is available for customers who prefer to pay off purchases over time, and the friendly staff help shoppers find the right sizes and styles. With Maynard Mall close to Wynberg's main transport links, the store is a handy stop for commuters as well as local families. Ackermans is at Shop 46, Maynard Mall, Main Road, Wynberg.

mr-price-rondebosch-cbd-rondebosch.description:
Mr Price Rondebosch CBD is the Mr Price store at Shop 6 in Rondebosch Main Centre on Main Road, popular with students from the nearby university and with local families. It offers trend-led fashion, footwear and everyday accessories at the low prices the value retailer is known for.

The rails carry casual streetwear, seasonal wardrobe staples and on-trend pieces that change regularly, so there is usually something new to find. Comfortable shoes and accessories make it easy to complete an outfit, and a cellular section sells affordable phones and related products. Checkout is quick and staff are friendly, which suits shoppers popping in between lectures or on the way home from work. For anyone in Rondebosch wanting to update their look without overspending, it is a convenient and budget-friendly choice close to campus. Mr Price is at Shop 6, Rondebosch Main Centre, Main Road, Rondebosch.

pick-n-pay-panorama-shopping-centre-pano.description:
Pick n Pay Panorama is the anchor supermarket in Panorama Shopping Centre on Hendrik Verwoerd Drive, a long-standing grocery stop for families in Panorama and the surrounding northern suburbs. It offers a full grocery shop, with a large fresh produce section, a butchery counter, a hot deli and an in-store bakery baking fresh bread and treats every day.

Shoppers often mention how clean and well organised the aisles are, which makes it quick to find what is needed, and the checkouts move efficiently even at busy times. Smart Shopper members can earn and redeem points on their purchases for extra savings. Parking at the centre makes it easy to load up after a big trolley shop, while the layout suits a quick top-up on the way home just as well. Pick n Pay is at Panorama Shopping Centre, 101 Hendrik Verwoerd Drive, Panorama.

fat-cats-and-dogs-noordhoek.description:
Fat Cats and Dogs is an independent pet store in The Post House at Noordhoek Farm Village on Chapman's Peak Drive, devoted to keeping local cats and dogs healthy and happy. It specialises in good nutrition, stocking leading cat and dog food brands, vet-recommended diets, natural treats and healthy chews.

Owners can also browse a carefully chosen range of accessories, including sturdy harnesses and leads, comfortable beds and interactive toys to keep pets busy. The farm village setting, with its relaxed country feel and family-friendly atmosphere, makes a visit easy to combine with a coffee or a meal nearby, and pets on a lead are welcome to come along. Friendly staff are happy to advise on the right food or product for each animal. For pet owners in Noordhoek and the surrounding valley, it is a welcoming local pet shop. Fat Cats and Dogs is at Shop 1, The Post House, Noordhoek Farm Village.

jet-delft-mall-delft.description:
Jet Delft Mall is the Delft branch of the national discount fashion chain, trading from Shop 3 in Delft Mall at the corner of Hindle Road and Delft Main Road. It is a popular stop for families who want to dress well while keeping costs down.

The store carries hard-wearing babywear, fun and trendy children's clothing and contemporary fashion for adults, along with comfortable footwear for the whole family. Beyond clothing, shoppers can find affordable cellphones and basic home textiles. To make shopping easier on the budget, Jet offers in-store credit and lay-by, allowing customers to spread the cost of larger purchases. Friendly staff are on hand to help with sizes and payment options. For Delft households, it is a convenient place to keep the family clothed at low prices close to home. Jet is at Shop 3, Delft Mall, Delft, Cape Town.

avenue-hardware-and-motor-spares-grassy-.description:
Avenue Hardware & Motor Spares is an independent store on 5th Avenue in Grassy Park that combines a hardware shop and a motor spares counter under one roof. It serves local contractors, DIY enthusiasts and vehicle owners, who can sort out a home repair and a car part in the same visit.

The hardware side stocks building materials, plumbing supplies, electrical components and hand tools for everything from a dripping tap to a small building job. On the automotive side, customers can buy service parts, oils and lubricants, and vehicle accessories to keep their cars running smoothly. Prices are competitive, and the knowledgeable staff give friendly, personal service, taking time to understand each job and recommend the right product. For Grassy Park households and tradespeople, it is a handy neighbourhood store for both home and vehicle needs. Avenue Hardware & Motor Spares is at 161 5th Avenue, Grassy Park.

dr-z-oliver-welgemoed.description:
This general dental practice on Kommissaris Street in the leafy suburb of Welgemoed looks after the oral health of the whole family. It offers a full range of everyday dentistry in a calm, welcoming setting, making regular visits to the dentist as easy and stress-free as possible.

Patients can book routine check-ups and thorough cleans to keep teeth and gums healthy, restorative treatment to repair teeth affected by decay or damage, and cosmetic treatments for anyone wanting to improve the look of their smile. The practice takes a patient-centred, gentle approach and uses modern dental equipment to make treatment comfortable and precise. Preventative care is a focus, helping patients avoid bigger problems in the future. For families in Welgemoed and the surrounding northern suburbs, it is a convenient practice for long-term dental care. The practice is at 36 Kommissaris Street, Welgemoed.

lifestyle-emporium-mouille-point.description:
Lifestyle Emporium is a hair and beauty salon on the corner of Surrey Place and Bay Road in Mouille Point, on Cape Town's Atlantic Seaboard. It offers clients a relaxing place to be pampered, with hair, beauty and wellness treatments available in one modern salon.

On the hair side, the stylists handle precision cuts, colour and styling tailored to each client. The beauty and wellness menu includes skincare facials, manicures and massage therapy, so clients can book a single treatment or combine several for a longer session of self-care. Quality professional products are used throughout, and the skilled team takes time to understand what each client wants before they begin. Its seaside location close to the promenade makes it easy for locals and visitors staying nearby to fit in an appointment. Lifestyle Emporium is on the corner of Surrey Place and Bay Road, Mouille Point.

mr-price-khayelitsha-mall-khayelitsha.description:
Mr Price Khayelitsha Mall is the Mr Price store at Shop 54 in Khayelitsha Mall on Julius Tsolo Street, a favourite with local families and fashion-conscious shoppers. It offers affordable, on-trend clothing, shoes and seasonal accessories for men, women and children.

The spacious store makes it easy to browse, with everyday wardrobe basics, casual streetwear, activewear and back-to-school clothing laid out clearly across the floor. New styles arrive regularly, so shoppers can keep up with the latest looks without spending much, and shoes and accessories help complete an outfit in one visit. The store has a lively, energetic feel, and friendly staff are on hand to help with sizes and styles. For Khayelitsha families wanting to update the whole household's wardrobe on a budget, it is a convenient stop inside the mall. Mr Price is at Shop 54, Khayelitsha Mall, 119 Julius Tsolo Street, Khayelitsha.

nedbank-the-point-sea-point.description:
Nedbank at The Point is a Nedbank branch on the second floor of The Point Shopping Centre on Regent Road, Sea Point. It serves a mix of local residents, working professionals and business owners along the Atlantic Seaboard, offering personal, business and wealth banking services.

Clients can handle their day-to-day transactions, open savings accounts and apply for personal loans or home loans with the help of the branch's consultants. Those looking to grow their money can get investment advice and talk through options for building long-term wealth, while business owners can manage their company banking here too. ATMs inside the branch make it simple and secure to deposit or withdraw cash. With the rest of the centre's shops close by, a visit to the bank fits easily into a regular errand run in Sea Point. Nedbank is at Shop 23, 2nd Floor, The Point, 76 Regent Road, Sea Point.

barracudas-fish-hoek.description:
Barracudas is a seafood restaurant on the Fish Hoek beachfront, at the corner of Beach Road and Recreation Road. Its seaside setting overlooking False Bay makes it a natural stop for a meal after a walk along the beach or a swim at one of the southern peninsula's most popular family beaches.

The menu centres on seafood, making it a good fit for locals and visitors who want to enjoy fresh flavours by the water. The relaxed, casual atmosphere suits families with children, groups of friends and couples alike, whether for a leisurely lunch or a relaxed early supper. For anyone spending the day in Fish Hoek, it offers a convenient place to sit back and enjoy a meal close to the sand. Barracudas is on the corner of Beach Road and Recreation Road, Fish Hoek, Cape Town.

busy-corner-bakery-grassy-park.description:
Busy Corner Bakery is a neighbourhood bakery on Victoria Road in Grassy Park, a popular daily stop for local residents and commuters on their way to work. It is known for affordable, freshly baked goods made each morning in classic Cape style.

The shelves fill up early with golden loaves of bread, traditional rolls and a choice of sweet and savoury pastries, ready for breakfast, lunch boxes or a treat with afternoon tea. The bakers also decorate cakes for birthdays, celebrations and other special occasions, so customers can order something made for their event. Service is friendly and quick, which helps when the morning queue builds, and the smell of fresh baking makes it hard to walk past without stopping. With deep roots in the community, the bakery has served many local families over the years. Busy Corner Bakery is at 77 Victoria Road, Grassy Park, Cape Town.

truworths-va-waterfront.description:
Truworths at the V&A Waterfront is the fashion retailer's store at Shop G108 in Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre, one of Cape Town's busiest shopping destinations. It attracts both local shoppers and visitors from around the world looking for contemporary South African fashion.

The collections cover clothing, footwear and accessories for men and women, from relaxed casual wear for weekends and smart formal pieces for the office to dressier evening outfits for special occasions. Accessories and shoes are displayed alongside the clothing, making it easy to put together a complete look in one visit. The ground-floor store offers attentive, helpful service, and its spot in Victoria Wharf means customers can combine shopping with dining, sightseeing and a stroll along the harbour. For tourists, it is also a chance to take home fashion from a well-known local brand. Truworths is at Shop G108, Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre, V&A Waterfront.

khaya-b-and-b-mandalay-mandalay.description:
Khaya B&B Mandalay is a bed and breakfast on Hermes Way in the residential suburb of Mandalay, offering a homely, welcoming place to stay. It caters for holidaymakers and business travellers alike, providing comfortable, secure overnight accommodation in a quiet neighbourhood setting.

The rooms are neatly furnished with the essentials for a restful stay, and each morning guests are served a freshly prepared breakfast to start the day. The hosts offer warm South African hospitality, helping visitors feel at home whether they are staying a single night or longer. The peaceful surroundings make it easy to unwind after a day of meetings or sightseeing, while good road links connect Mandalay to the wider Cape Town area. It makes a practical base for exploring the region. Khaya B&B is at 12 Hermes Way, Mandalay, Cape Town.

dis-chem-sunnydale.description:
Dis-Chem Sunnydale is the Dis-Chem store in Sun Valley Mall, at the corner of Ou Kaapse Weg and Noordhoek Main Road, serving families in Sunnydale, Noordhoek and the surrounding valley. Its dispensary fills prescriptions and its pharmacists give professional advice, while clinic consultations are available for everyday health needs such as check-ups and minor ailments.

The large retail floor stocks a wide range of health products, beauty and cosmetics, baby-care essentials and nutritional supplements, so customers can pick up medication, toiletries and nappies in one trip. Dis-Chem's focus on affordability helps households keep the cost of looking after the family's health down. Being in the valley's main shopping centre makes it easy to combine a pharmacy visit with groceries and other errands. Dis-Chem is at Shop 15, Sun Valley Mall, corner Ou Kaapse Weg and Noordhoek Main Road, Sunnydale.

lavis-hardware-bishop-lavis.description:
Lavis Hardware is a neighbourhood hardware store at Shop 6 in the Shoprite Wing centre on Lavis Drive, serving homeowners, tenants and contractors in Bishop Lavis. It stocks a broad range of building materials, tools, plumbing supplies and electrical essentials for jobs around the home and on site.

Residents tackling their own repairs and improvements can find what they need for anything from fixing a leaking pipe to building a boundary wall, while professional builders and handymen can source trade supplies without travelling far. Staff are practical and knowledgeable, offering sensible advice on the right materials and quantities for each job. Prices are kept affordable, which matters for households doing maintenance on a budget. Its spot in a busy shopping centre means customers can pick up hardware while doing their grocery shopping. Lavis Hardware is at Shop 6, Shoprite Wing, Lavis Drive, Bishop Lavis.

the-crazy-store-piazza-centre-parklands.description:
The Crazy Store Piazza Centre is a large branch of the South African value and variety chain, spread across Shops 3 to 5 in the Piazza Centre at the corner of Parklands Main Road and Link Road. Shoppers come for the low prices and stay for the treasure-hunt feel of browsing aisles packed with useful and fun finds.

The range includes kitchenware and household items, toys and novelties, party supplies for birthdays and celebrations, stationery for school and the office, pet products and seasonal gifts that change through the year. Because there is so much variety, it is a handy place to pick up a last-minute present, decorate for a party or restock everyday basics without spending much. For Parklands families watching their budgets, it is a convenient local stop for value buys. The Crazy Store is at Shops 3, 4 and 5, Piazza Centre, Parklands, Cape Town.

the-potluck-club-woodstock.description:
The Potluck Club is a restaurant on the top floor of the Silo Building at The Old Biscuit Mill on Albert Road, Woodstock. From its high vantage point, diners take in sweeping views across the city, the harbour and Table Mountain while they eat.

The menu is built around inventive small plates designed for sharing, inspired by flavours from around the world and grouped by taste: sweet, sour, salty, bitter and umami. Guests are encouraged to order a range of dishes for the table and explore different combinations as the meal goes on. An open kitchen adds energy to the room, and the stylish industrial-chic interior suits the building's history as part of an old biscuit factory. It is a popular choice for food lovers wanting a memorable meal out, a celebration with friends or a special date night. The Potluck Club is at the Silo, top floor, The Old Biscuit Mill, 373–375 Albert Road, Woodstock.

westridge-hardware-westridge.description:
Westridge Hardware is a neighbourhood hardware store in the Westridge Centre on Simonsig Road, serving households and builders in Westridge and the surrounding parts of Mitchells Plain. Its shelves carry a wide stock of building supplies, hand tools, plumbing fittings and electrical components.

Homeowners upgrading a kitchen or bathroom, repairing a roof or putting up shelves can find the materials they need, while local contractors use the store to pick up supplies for trade jobs in the area. The team gives helpful, practical advice on choosing the right products and getting the job done properly, which is especially useful for first-time DIYers. Affordable prices help families keep up with home maintenance without overspending. Being in a local shopping centre, it is easy to reach and quick to visit between other errands. Westridge Hardware is at the Westridge Centre, Simonsig Road, Westridge, Mitchells Plain.

bergvliet-pet-centre-bergvliet.description:
Bergvliet Pet Centre is a neighbourhood pet shop in the Sherwood Centre, at the corner of Children's Way and Dreyersdal Road, caring for the pets of families in Bergvliet and the nearby southern suburbs. It caters for dogs, cats, birds and small animals, with everything needed to keep them healthy and content.

The store stocks quality pet foods and nutritious treats, durable toys for play and enrichment, and essential pet healthcare products. The staff know their animals and are happy to give practical advice on diet and general wellbeing, whether a customer has just brought home a puppy or is caring for an older cat. Its friendly, welcoming atmosphere and convenient local spot make it easy to stock up on pet supplies during a regular shopping trip. Bergvliet Pet Centre is at the Sherwood Centre, corner Children's Way and Dreyersdal Road, Bergvliet.

debonairs-pizza-delft-mall-delft.description:
Debonairs Pizza Delft Mall is a branch of the popular South African pizza chain, operating from Shop 1 in Delft Mall at the corner of Hindle and Delft Main roads. It offers takeaway and delivery, bringing hot, freshly made pizza to homes across Delft and the surrounding area.

The menu includes the chain's well-known Triple-Decker pizza with its layers of cheese and toppings, along with favourites such as sweet chilli chicken and a choice of classic pizzas, plus sides that make it easy to feed a group. Combo and sharing deals suit family suppers, parties and gatherings with friends. Orders are prepared quickly and packed to arrive hot, whether customers collect from the store or have them delivered. For Delft households wanting an easy, satisfying meal without cooking, it is a convenient local choice. Debonairs Pizza is at Shop 1, Delft Mall, Delft, Cape Town.

dr-bianca-barron-steenberg.description:
This general practice at Shop 1B in the Foodprop Centre on Military Road, Steenberg, provides primary healthcare for individuals and families in the surrounding community. Being based in a local shopping centre makes it easy for patients to reach and to fit an appointment around work, school or errands.

The doctor treats acute illnesses, helps patients manage long-term chronic conditions and carries out general medical examinations, with a strong focus on preventative medicine to keep patients well. Diagnostic support helps pinpoint the cause of symptoms so the right treatment can begin quickly. The practice combines a professional clinical setting with a compassionate, patient-centred manner, taking the time to listen and explain each step of care. For Steenberg residents looking for a dependable local doctor for the whole family, it offers accessible, everyday healthcare close to home. The practice is at Shop 1B, Foodprop Centre, 545 Military Road, Steenberg.

ocean-basket-vangate-mall-athlone.description:
Ocean Basket Vangate Mall is a branch of the South African seafood restaurant chain, at Shop 76 in Vangate Mall on the corner of Vanguard Drive and Klipfontein Road, Athlone. It brings the chain's Mediterranean-inspired seafood to families and shoppers in Athlone and the surrounding suburbs.

The menu covers fish and chips, grilled prawns, seafood platters made for sharing and freshly made sushi, along with other dishes from the sea. Portions are generous and prices are kept affordable, so a family meal out does not have to be a special-occasion expense. The relaxed, welcoming restaurant suits a lunch break during a shopping trip, a casual supper with the children or a get-together with friends. Being inside one of Athlone's main malls makes it easy to combine a meal with other errands. Ocean Basket is at Shop 76, Vangate Mall, Athlone, Cape Town.
